Kalyan Nadh Somavarapu

kalyannathsomavarapu@gmail.com | +91 7024779772

SUMMARY

Backend-focused Fullstack Developer with 4+ years of experience building scalable Node.js applications, REST APIs, automation workflows, third-party integrations, and serverless solutions. Experienced in designing data synchronization processes, scheduled jobs, cloud-native services, and geospatial applications using ArcGIS and QGIS. Strong background in database optimization, production issue troubleshooting, system design, and enterprise software development.

EDUCATION

INDIAN INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY (IIT), Roorkee Master of Technology, CGPA: 8.35 / 10, Research Fellowship | Aug 2020 – Sep 2022

Aug 2018 – Apr 2020

NATIONAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY (NIT), Bhopal Bachelor of Planning, CGPA: 7.05 / 10

Aug 2014 – Apr 2018

EXPERIENCE

Software Engineer (Fullstack)

Sep 2024 – July 2026

COGNITIVZEN TECHNOLOGIES (Client: Microsoft) Tech Stack: React.js | TypeScript

Designed and implemented scalable UI modules for Microsoft Purview enterprise platform • Improved application usability by ~30% and enhanced frontend performance by ~20–25% • Integrated frontend services with large-scale backend APIs and enterprise workflows • Developed reusable component architecture reducing development effort and improving maintainability • Collaborated cross-functionally to deliver high-quality production releases May 2024 – Sep 2024

Designed and implemented scalable UI modules for Microsoft Purview enterprise platform • Improved application usability by ~30% and enhanced frontend performance by ~20–25% • Integrated frontend services with large-scale backend APIs and enterprise workflows • Developed reusable component architecture reducing development effort and improving maintainability • Collaborated cross-functionally to deliver high-quality production releases May 2024 – Sep 2024

Architected and developed fullstack platform for real-time drone telemetry and analytics • Built scalable REST APIs and interactive dashboards supporting continuous mission tracking • Designed modular services supporting multi-client and device scalability • Improved system responsiveness and operational monitoring capabilities

Fullstack Developer CHINTHAKINDI TECHNOLOGIES Tech Stack: Node.js | Express JS| React.js | Next JS | GCP | PostgreSQL | MongoDB |

Mar 2022 – Apr 2024

Developed and maintained scalable backend services and distributed applications • Built REST APIs supporting raffle lifecycle management and scheduling workflows • Implemented automation services using cron jobs improving operational efficiency • Reduced API latency by ~25–35% through optimization and efficient database design • Improved frontend responsiveness and application performance by ~20–30% • Deployed cloud-native services using GCP Cloud Functions

ACADEMIC ACHIEVEMENTS

Won 2nd Prize in ESRI young indian scholar program 2022 - Automatic Ridge Line Detection using Digital Elevation Model

PROJECTS

MICROSOFT PURVIEW PORTAL | Software Engineer | Oct 2024 – Present Tech Stack: React.js | TypeScript | API Integration

Delivered enterprise UI modules supporting governance and data management workflows • Improved rendering performance and user experience through frontend optimization • Built reusable architecture accelerating future development cycles

AgriGCS DASHBOARD | Associate Solution Leader | May 2024 – Sep 2024 Tech Stack: Express.js | Next.js | Real-Time Systems

Developed analytics platform for live drone data collection and monitoring • Implemented scalable APIs and real-time dashboards • Designed telemetry workflows for large-scale operational tracking

RAFFLERRA PLATFORM & ADMIN CONSOLE | Fullstack Developer | Feb 2023 – Apr 2024 Tech Stack: NestJS | React.js | Firebase | Firestore DB | CloudSQL | Firebase Auth | GCP

Developed backend services supporting event lifecycle and scheduling workflows • Automated event execution processes reducing manual operations • Improved application performance and API responsiveness • Deployed scalable services using cloud infrastructure

PLAY FUTURE TRADERS & ADMIN CONSOLE | Fullstack Developer | Oct 2022 – Jan 2023 Tech Stack: React.js | Express.js | Firebase | Firestore DB | CloudSQL | Firebase Auth | GCP

Built scalable APIs and administration dashboards • Reduced application response times by ~20% • Designed reusable modules supporting long-term scalability

RIGHT ERP SOFTWARE | Fullstack Developer | Apr 2022 – Sep 2022 Tech Stack: Express.js | MySQL

Optimized SQL queries reducing system latency by ~30% • Developed reporting APIs and analytics dashboards • Implemented geospatial processing workflows using Python and GIS tools

EARTHQUAKE LOSS ESTIMATION TOOL | Junior Research Fellow | Aug 2020 – Sep 2022 Tech Stack: React.js | Python | QGIS | ArcGIS

Developed visualization interfaces for seismic and terrain analysis • Automated analytical workflows using Python • Built 3D geographic modeling solutions • Worked with geospatial datasets and GIS processing workflows.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Languages: JavaScript, TypeScript, Python Backend: Node.js, Express.js, NestJS, REST APIs, Microservices, API Design, Authentication, Cron Jobs, Event-Based Architecture Frontend: React.js, Next.js, Redux Toolkit, Tailwind CSS, Responsive UI Development Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Query Optimization, Database Design and troubleshooting Cloud & DevOps: Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Firebase, Docker, Cloud Functions, CI/CD Tools: Git, Postman, npm, Agile Methodology, SDLC Core Competencies: System Design, Performance Optimization, Scalable Architecture, Real-Time Applications, Distributed Systems, Code Reusability, Application Monitoring GIS & Geospatial: ArcGIS, QGIS, Shapefile Processing, Geospatial Analysis, Spatial Visualization

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

Experience: 4+ Years Domains: Enterprise Applications | Analytics Platforms | Admin Systems | Cloud Solutions Strengths: Backend Development | API Engineering | System Design | Performance Optimization | Cloud Deployments | Fullstack Architecture
